## `German Legal Person with Initials in Name`

**F1:** 0.779 | **Precision:** 0.902 | **Recall:** 0.685  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `eb9ae69d`  
**Description:**
Matches persons with standard titles (Dr., Mag., etc.) followed by a name, excluding compound titles handled by other rules and stopping at the first surname to avoid partial matches of longer names.

**Content:**
```

```

## `German Legal Person Simple Name after Preposition 'von'`

**F1:** 0.005 | **Precision:** 0.013 | **Recall:** 0.003  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `f7a1fc96`  
**Description:**
Matches names following 'von' ONLY if the preceding word is not a title (Dr., Mag., etc.) and the following word is not a common legal noun, to avoid matching 'Dr. Thomas Walzel von Wiesentreu' as 'Walzel' or 'Wiesentreu'.

## `German Legal Person Simple Name after Legal Roles`

**F1:** 0.000 | **Precision:** 0.000 | **Recall:** 0.000  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `8cfac08f`  
**Description:**
Matches simple first and last names appearing immediately after specific legal roles (Senatspräsident, Hofrat, etc.) to capture names like 'Dr. Baumann' or 'Laura Aleite' when the role precedes the name. Requires a valid name pattern to avoid partial matches.

## `German Legal Person Simple Name after Verbs`

**F1:** 0.000 | **Precision:** 0.000 | **Recall:** 0.000  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `07cbe754`  
**Description:**
Captures simple names (First Last) appearing after common legal verbs like 'informiert', 'kann', 'wird', 'hat' to handle cases like 'Laura Aleite kann' or 'Zoltan Ansel den Kunden', but only if followed by a period or end of sentence to avoid matching street names.

**Content:**
```
(?:informiert|kann|wird|hat|wurde|sind|ist|werden|haben|hatten|konnte|konnten|sollte|sollten|muss|müssen|durfte|durften|wollte|wollten|hatte|hatten|ging|gingen|kam|kamen|sagte|sagten|teilte|teilte|berichtet|berichtet|erwähnt|erwähnt|nennt|nennt|nennt|nennt|wurde|begehrt)\s+([A-Z][a-z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df\u00c4\u00d6\u00dc\u00e9\u00e8\u00ea\u00eb\u00e0\u00e2\u00e4\u00ee\u00ef\u00f4\u00fb\u00f9\u00e7\u00e9\u00e8\u00ea\u00eb\u00e0\u00e2\u00e4\u00ee\u00ef\u00f4\u00fb\u00f9\u00e7]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df\u00c4\u00d6\u00dc\u00e9\u00e8\u00ea\u00eb\u00e0\u00e2\u00e4\u00ee\u00ef\u00f4\u00fb\u00f9\u00e7\u00e9\u00e8\u00ea\u00eb\u00e0\u00e2\u00e4\u00ee\u00ef\u00f4\u00fb\u00f9\u00e7]+)*)\b(?=\s*(?:\.|,|\)|\]|$))
```

## `German Legal Person Simple Name after Preposition 'von'`

**F1:** 0.005 | **Precision:** 0.013 | **Recall:** 0.003  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `f7a1fc96`  
**Description:**
Matches names following 'von' ONLY if the preceding word is not a title (Dr., Mag., etc.) and the following word is not a common legal noun, to avoid matching 'Dr. Thomas Walzel von Wiesentreu' as 'Walzel' or 'Wiesentreu'.

## `German Legal Person with Simple Name in List`

**F1:** 0.001 | **Precision:** 0.002 | **Recall:** 0.000  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `493ee228`  
**Description:**
Matches simple names in a list context ONLY if the preceding item is a title (Dr., Mag., etc.) or a known person name pattern, to avoid matching street names or generic terms.

Captures simple names (First Last) appearing after common legal verbs like 'informiert', 'kann', 'wird', 'hat' to handle cases like 'Laura Aleite kann' or 'Zoltan Ansel den Kunden', but only if followed by a period or end of sentence to avoid matching street names.

**Content:**
```
(?:informiert|kann|wird|hat|wurde|sind|ist|werden|haben|hatten|konnte|konnten|sollte|sollten|muss|müssen|durfte|durften|wollte|wollten|hatte|hatten|ging|gingen|kam|kamen|sagte|sagten|teilte|teilte|berichtet|berichtet|erwähnt|erwähnt|nennt|nennt|nennt|nennt|wurde|begehrt)\s+([A-Z][a-z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df\u00c4\u00d6\u00dc\u00e9\u00e8\u00ea\u00eb\u00e0\u00e2\u00e4\u00ee\u00ef\u00f4\u00fb\u00f9\u00e7\u00e9\u00e8\u00ea\u00eb\u00e0\u00e2\u00e4\u00ee\u00ef\u00f4\u00fb\u00f9\u00e7]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df\u00c4\u00d6\u00dc\u00e9\u00e8\u00ea\u00eb\u00e0\u00e2\u00e4\u00ee\u00ef\u00f4\u00fb\u00f9\u00e7\u00e9\u00e8\u00ea\u00eb\u00e0\u00e2\u00e4\u00ee\u00ef\u00f4\u00fb\u00f9\u00e7]+)*)\b(?=\s*(?:\.|,|\)|\]|$))
```
